function.description:
**Pick this tool for backup JOB HISTORY and restore JOB HISTORY questions.**

This tool lists backup and restore execution history with optional filtering by backup, job type, status, pagination, and sorting.

**Use this tool when the user asks:**
- about backup jobs or restore jobs
- for failed backup executions or failed restore attempts
- whether any backup or restore job is in progress
- for execution history for a known backup
- for restore attempts, delete-backup jobs, or job status trends

**Pick this tool for questions like:**
- "Show me backup jobs"
- "List restore attempts"
- "Are there any backups in progress?"
- "Which backup jobs failed?"
- "Show execution history for backup <id>"
- "List failed restore jobs"
- "Show recent backup executions"

**Do NOT use this tool for:**
- listing available backups themselves
- backup configuration/settings
- mounted backup storage capacity
- detailed diagnostics for one specific execution after you already have the execution ID

This is the list view for executions. When the user needs detailed diagnostics for one execution, first obtain the execution `id` here and then call `api_getBackupRestoreExecution`.
function.name: api_getBackupRestoreExecutions

backupId.description: Optional backup UUID used to filter execution history for a single backup. Obtain this value from the `id` field returned by `api_getAllBackup`.

jobType.description: Optional execution type filter. Use `CREATE_BACKUP` for backup creation jobs, `RESTORE_BACKUP` for restore jobs, and `DELETE_BACKUP` for backup deletion jobs.

limit.description: Optional maximum number of execution records to return. Valid range is 1-500.

offset.description: Optional 1-based starting offset for pagination. Use 1 for the first page, then increase it to page through additional execution records.

order.description: Optional sort direction. Use `desc` for latest executions first and `asc` for oldest-first ordering.

sortBy.description: Optional execution response field to sort by. The common default is `executionDate`.

status.description: Optional execution status filter. Useful values include `IN_PROGRESS`, `SUCCESS`, `FAILED`, `TIMEOUT`, and `TERMINATED`.

responses.description: Contains the information about backup executions..

filter.description: Records are filtered based on the fields

count.description: Total number of records that can be returned for this request

limit.description: Number of records to be returned in response

offset.description: Starting offset of data to fetch and returned

name.description: Records are sorted based on the field specified.

order.description: Sort order. 'asc' for ascending and 'desc' for descending

items.description: Contains the information about backup execution.

createdBy.description: This field represents the user who triggered this execution

duration.description: Total time taken to complete this execution process

endDate.description: The end data and time of the backup execution

errorCode.description: Error code of the backup execution process

errorMessage.description: Error message of this backup execution process

failedTaskDetail.description: Failed task detail of this execution

id.description: The UUID of the execution process

isForceUpdate.description: This states whether the execution is forcefully updated or not

scope.description: The backup scope states whether the backup is with assurance or without assurance data

startDate.description: The start data and time of the backup execution

status.description: The status of the backup execution

systemErrorMessage.description: System error message of this backup execution process
